groups.problem: Login-cache invalidation excludes non-public organization IDPs even though organization-specific login caches can contain them.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same overly restrictive BROKER_PUBLIC predicate as the reason membership changes leave organization-specific caches stale. S6 points to the predicate definition, while S7 points to the invalidation methods using it.
